options.content:
## Traffic & Capacity
Offered load and headroom, from the CDR hypertable (`voip-cdr-pg`). **CPS** = seizures/sec (rate of `start_time`); **concurrent calls** = CDR time-overlap (`answer_time <= t < end_time`) — NOT `active_calls`, which is only populated by the programmable-voice API path and is empty for the RCF traffic that dominates production. Rated capacity is **~500 CPS per zone**; the headroom gauges compare live CPS to that. Zone is `split_part(sbc_id,'-',1)`.

panels.title: CPS over time — per zone (1m rate)
panels.description: Calls per second per zone = seizures per 1-minute bucket / 60. Zone from split_part(sbc_id,'-',1). Shows all zones side by side (NOT filtered by the Zone variable) so you can watch load distribution. The ~500 CPS/zone capacity line is drawn as a red threshold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1m') AS time, CASE WHEN sbc_id IS NULL OR sbc_id = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE split_part(sbc_id,'-',1) END AS zone, count(*)::float / 60.0 AS cps FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Concurrent calls over time — per zone (CDR overlap, 1m)
panels.description: Concurrent calls sampled at each 1-minute boundary: a call counts at bucket t if it was answered before t and hung up after t (answer_time <= t AND end_time > t). Uses generate_series over the range crossed with cdrs. Zone from sbc_id. This is the historical concurrency curve; the big-stat 'now' value is on Voice Products.

targets.rawSql: SELECT g.t AS time, CASE WHEN c.sbc_id IS NULL OR c.sbc_id = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE split_part(c.sbc_id,'-',1) END AS zone, count(c.uuid) AS concurrent FROM generate_series($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 minute') AS g(t) JOIN cdrs c ON c.answer_time IS NOT NULL AND c.answer_time <= g.t AND c.end_time > g.t AND c.start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '1 day' AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Call volume per zone — hourly (stacked)
panels.description: Seized calls per hour per zone, stacked, from raw cdrs (zone from sbc_id). Whole-platform offered volume over the range. All zones shown regardless of the Zone filter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(start_time, '1h') AS time, CASE WHEN sbc_id IS NULL OR sbc_id = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE split_part(sbc_id,'-',1) END AS zone, count(*) AS calls FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Call volume per product — hourly (stacked)
panels.description: Seized calls per hour by product_type (rcf / api / trunk / hybrid) from cdr_hourly_stats — the cheap continuous aggregate has product_type, so this is efficient. Customer-scoped aggregate has no zone, so this is all-zones. Shows the traffic mix.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroup(hour, '1h') AS time, product_type, sum(total_calls) AS calls FROM cdr_hourly_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Peak CPS vs 500/zone capacity — per zone (range)
panels.description: For each zone: the busiest 1-minute CPS observed over the current range, gauged against the ~500 CPS/zone rating. This is the headroom check — a zone approaching 500 needs a second SBC pair or a new zone. Peak (not average) is used deliberately: capacity must cover the busy minute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT zone, max(cps) AS peak_cps FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN sbc_id IS NULL OR sbc_id = '' THEN 'unknown' ELSE split_part(sbc_id,'-',1) END AS zone, date_trunc('minute', start_time) AS minute, count(*)::float / 60.0 AS cps FROM cdrs WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1, 2) s GROUP BY zone ORDER BY zone;

panels.title: Busy hour — top hours by seized calls (range + zone)
panels.description: The highest-volume clock hours over the current range for the selected zone: seized, answered, ASR, peak-minute CPS within that hour, and Erlang-hours of answered traffic (answered call-seconds / 3600). The classic capacity-planning 'busy hour' view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', start_time) AS hour, count(*) AS seized, count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL) AS answered, (count(*) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL))::float / NULLIF(count(*), 0) AS asr, max(m.cps) AS peak_cps, sum(billable_ms) FILTER (WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL)::float / 1000.0 / 3600.0 AS erlang_hours FROM cdrs c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*)::float / 60.0 AS cps FROM cdrs c2 WHERE c2.sbc_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.sbc_id AND date_trunc('minute', c2.start_time) = date_trunc('minute', c.start_time)) m ON true WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY seized DESC LIMIT 24;

panels.title: Live load — CPS now / peak (1h) / concurrent now (selected zone)
panels.description: At-a-glance current load for the selected zone. CPS now = last 60s seizures/60. Peak CPS (1h) = busiest minute in the last hour. Concurrent now = CDR overlap at this instant. Compare CPS to the 500/zone rating.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*)::float / 60.0 FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 minute' AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone') AS "CPS now", (SELECT COALESCE(max(cps), 0) FROM (SELECT count(*)::float / 60.0 AS cps FROM cdrs WHERE start_time > now() - interval '1 hour' AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone' GROUP BY date_trunc('minute', start_time)) s) AS "Peak CPS (1h)", (SELECT count(*) FROM cdrs WHERE answer_time IS NOT NULL AND answer_time <= now() AND end_time > now() AND start_time > now() - interval '6 hours' AND split_part(coalesce(sbc_id,''),'-',1) LIKE '$zone') AS "Concurrent now";

list.name: zone
list.label: Zone
list.description: Filter by zone, derived from split_part(sbc_id,'-',1). 'All' = SQL LIKE '%'. Per-zone timeseries (CPS, concurrent, volume) always show every zone; the headroom/busy-hour/live-load panels honour this filter.
list.query: All : %, East : east, West : west, Central : central
